title: Staging build bakes in stale sign-in redirect URLs (amplify_outputs from the backend at build time): staging rebuild required after any backend callback change
description: On p.apyr.us (papyrus-production) the staging build embedded redirect_sign_in_uri without the staging default URL because it was generated before the main backend deploy that registered it, so sign-in on staging failed with "redirect is coming from a different origin". A staging rebuild fixed it. Template/package follow-up: either trigger the staging rebuild whenever the main backend deploys (a post-build hook or the content-actions/stack), or have the staging build regenerate outputs from the live backend after the main deploy completes; document in docs/site-hosting.md. Seen 2026-10-10.
